messages.author: cf47bbe63da1f3ae
messages.subject: Save specific elements from model block
parts: I guess the answer is probably just 'no', but is there any way to save a specific element of the model block? The element comes about as a result of various other processes that involve elements I don't want to save out.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save specific elements from model block
parts:
The answer is no.

The solution is simple:
create a generated quantities block. Copy what you want into a generated quantity.



Daniel

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save specific elements from model block
parts:
Whoops -- I was wrong. If you have it in a local variable, you won't have access in the generated quantities to save it directly.

With that said, just copy the computation to the generated quantities and save what you need. It's fast there. It might be a little bit of book keeping, but if you've already figured that out, you can essentially copy the model block over to generated quantities.


Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save specific elements from model block
parts:
If you need all those other variables in the model block
and don't want to save them, there's not a good solution.

If you don't need the other variables, you can declare the
variable you do want to save as a transformed parameter.

- Bob
